title: Shipping costs without the branching
summary: Refactor a branch-heavy shipping cost function into a small, table-driven one with the same behavior.
instructions: The starter code computes shipping costs correctly, but every zone and option adds another branch.
Keep the behavior and reduce the decision logic, for example by moving the rates into a lookup table.
shipping_cost(weight_kg, zone, express) returns the cost in cents: base + per_kg x weight_kg, where express doubles the base only.
Rates (base, per kg): domestic 500 and 100, europe 900 and 250, world 1500 and 400.
Return -1 for an unknown zone, or when weight_kg is not between 1 and 30.
constraints: Every function has a cyclomatic complexity of at most 4.
Control flow is nested at most 2 levels deep.

acceptance_criteria.description: The examples return the expected costs.
